title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: 2-D conservative perfect-gas equations and reference coefficients source/report-supported.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS TRI_3/QUAD_4 multizone topology, boundary families and geometry present; MIXED unsupported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Conservative face residual and global norms present; no independent smooth-order validation.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux implemented; excessive low-Mach dissipation suspected for no Re200 shedding, as disclosed in final response.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic boundary paths; report notes first-order-accurate viscous wall treatment.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ/Venkat reconstruction and invalid-face fallback present; report says fallback does not change order, and no independent smooth-order test.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat limiter active in source; face positivity fallback exists and historic executable unbound.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:713–722 correctly projects tangential wall shear; low-Mach M015 laminar Cd0.239 and Re20 Cd2.812 limit accuracy.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS steady path implemented; M2 early residual-only stopping leaves large force drift.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 frozen physical histories exist, but early stagnation exit is omitted from miss count and reconstruction is frozen in inner solve without refreshed ratio recheck; actual strict miss fraction unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS/local halos exist, but global Mesh remains allocated on every rank throughout solver execution in violation of TASK.md:227.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
